note: Data do not uniquely identify fitness parameters — observations insufficient to constrain trajectory shape. Reporting the minimum selection coefficient (s_min=0.1501) assuming dominance h=0.25 (Lynd et al. 2010), fitted to a target of 0.984984 derived as the 95% binomial lower bound from n=198 sampled chromosomes. The bound is stable across dominance: sweeping h from 0.05 to 0.65 gives s_min between 0.1485 and 0.1776.
